checks.finding: Exact supplied Quack server and process-serialized coordinator types, original gateway/connection/lock/identity/config/process and owner-controlled authority file/parent identities are retained. No separate authority adapter or store is selected by the guard.
checks.name: original_existing_authority_custody

checks.finding: Actual native task row must be unique and in progress. Alias, exact integer revision, full bounded canonical body and exact admitted phase/claim/process receipt are checked. The full body CID is derived without planning-contract substitution, metadata removal, alias normalization or semantic-ID inference.
checks.name: strict_actual_native_task_snapshot

checks.finding: Kernel PID/UID/start ticks must reproduce the selected live daemon peer; the original gateway active grant must reproduce the native process attestation and expected daemon client ID. No runtime-bootstrap, allocation or compiled-context receipt is invented.
checks.name: active_owner_attested_peer_grant

checks.finding: Existing execute_with_task_claim_fence acquires coordinator custody before SERVER. Callback reads repeat the native snapshot; a final SERVER read follows the native coordinator postcheck. Source-only require_source_binding does not acquire the coordinator; lifecycle checks avoid is_open lock acquisition under SERVER.
checks.name: native_claim_fence_and_lock_order

checks.finding: Native fencing checks current running claim/lease/latest fence/noncompletion before and after the callback, but retains normal metadata/lease-event/expiry effects. Its existing process-serialized opening path is not a zero-write observer or strict read-before-repair integrity audit.
checks.name: native_normal_bookkeeping_boundary

checks.finding: Actual task CID/revision/fullbody CID are supplied from the pinned snapshot. Caller independently supplies existing CAS/inventory/request/root/context/bounds. Finally retains any actually published reader and marker even when later validation raises; consumed publication is not silently undone or rebound.
checks.name: bind_once_partial_publication_custody

checks.finding: A guard-marked reader requires the same exact private admission handle in the broker. Original handle identity and same server/reader/CAS/root/canonical task binding are rechecked. Default task_admission=None preserves the existing generic reader path for unmarked readers.
checks.name: exact_reader_marker_and_optional_guard

checks.finding: Validated native success response byte/wire counters are charged before a later task fence may refuse publication. Final task fence occurs after canonical CAS replay and before both closing full working-source reads. No zero-cost or no-prior-effect inference follows refusal.
checks.name: backend_cost_before_later_refusal

checks.finding: Detached snapshot carries actual bounded task identities and task_content_read_only, with proof/execution/completion/allocation flags false. New task guard data is not added to worker responses; no new owner locator/token/DB path is exposed.
checks.name: private_owner_data_and_authority_boundary

checks.finding: This component does not alter ordinary Terminal allocation, remote OWNER_ENTRY handoff or direct coding-child Popen registration. Parallel semantic working-source refresh remains separate from the native clean committed-source profile; IR inventories, embeddings and decoder checkpoint assets are unchanged.
checks.name: normal_terminal_activation_and_assets

scope_limits: The actual existing daemon adapter permits require_existing_authority=False. Its normal native opening path can repair metadata before the claim callback; metadata-only prior corruption may be repaired while a genuine live claim still passes. Strict read-before-repair schema integrity needs a native contract extension or separately qualified existing-only prerequisite.
Physical authority replacement, absent or foreign native claims and mismatched actual owner/process/task snapshots are checked; this review does not claim every prior schema corruption is rejected.
Owner-attested active daemon grant is not an independently replayed runtime bootstrap, sealed allocation, compiled context or authenticated remote coding launch.
The existing direct coding-child Popen registration rule remains. A broader daemon/run root cannot substitute for the actual coding child; normal Terminal transport is not automatically activated.

Source/currentness and coordinator checks are sequential, without a filesystem writer lease or cross-store atomic transaction. Failed post-publication binding can retain the consumed native reader and host cleanup duty.
Direct privileged native SDK reads retain generic task-body/source-currentness checks; they do not automatically execute this optional broker coordinator fence.

Native successful response byte counters exclude unknown handshake/error/partial transport costs and provider input/output/cached usage. No token savings, official reward, live model helper choice or proof/omission/completion authority is established.
Semantic working-source snapshots can be unverified through their separate channel. Native source edits still require fresh native task/source admission under its clean committed profile.
